CustomField.description: Lets Agentforce agents use this config through the Site Search action. Off by default: a service agent runs as its own agent user, whose access can differ from a site visitor's, so an admin chooses which configs agents may use (typically ones with only public content).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Allow Agentforce agents to search with this config. Only turn on for configs whose results the agent user may share with anyone it talks to.
CustomField.label: Allow Agent Access
